reasoning: 1. TARGET ENGAGEMENT: No biomarker or PD data available to assess whether CPI-613 engaged mitochondrial enzymes. The trial provides no evidence of target engagement. 2. PATHWAY MODULATION: No pathway biomarkers or downstream readouts reported to assess whether mitochondrial dysfunction was induced. 3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Primary endpoint (OS) failed across all three dose arms with median OS of 4.7, 1.6, and 3.94 months respectively. No dose-response relationship observed. PFS also failed across all arms. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: No meaningful subgroup responses - only 4/17 patients achieved stable disease while 11/17 had progressive disease. No biomarker-defined responders identified. 5. CONFOUNDERS: This was a single-arm Phase I dose-escalation study with only 17 patients and no control arm, making it severely underpowered for efficacy assessment. The study design was inappropriate for drawing conclusions about efficacy in this indication.
